canonical_direct_consumption.basis: Each promoted KnowledgeObjectPackage contains exact input lineage, method and parameters, applicability, 28 validated result records, limitations, lifecycle state, fingerprints and executable rerun provenance. A read-only consumer can use those records directly.

postgresql_projection_consumption.basis: The isolated 562-package projection rebuilt and verified exactly; both pilot packages were retrieved by family and their complete canonical JSONB payloads exposed indicator, territory, period, method, transformations, applicability basis, bundle and lifecycle state.
postgresql_projection_consumption.limitation: The generic filter API directly indexes evidence_family, statement_type, lifecycle_state and package_fingerprint. Indicator, territory, period, method, transformation and applicability are retrievable from payload JSONB but are not all first-class filters.

relationship_export_v1.classification: content-contract mismatch, not a canonical-package or projection failure
relationship_export_v1.reason: knowledgeforge_relationship_export_v1 is relationship-specific. It preserves the canonical package but emits relationship metadata fields that are null or semantically inapplicable for baseline-characterization packages.

insightforge_adapter_contract.assessment: No accepted general InsightForge adapter contract was found. Direct canonical-package or read-only projection consumption is content-adequate, but an InsightForge-specific compatibility claim would be unsupported until a consumer contract is separately authorized and tested.
